note: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the harakat page. vowels[]: mark (the combining character), name/ar/suffix/desc, and audio{} — a PLACEHOLDER map from syllable text to a recording file (e.g. "بَ": "recordings/ba_fatha.mp3"). Until recordings exist the page speaks each syllable with the browser's Arabic voice; any syllable present in audio{} plays the real recording instead, so recordings can be added letter by letter with no code change. letters[]: base form + transliteration. Shadda rows pair the doubling mark with each vowel; Madd rows append the lengthening letter (the mark string may be mark+letter).
audio_note: Audio placeholder: syllables currently use the device's built-in Arabic voice. As teacher recordings are made, they drop into a recordings/ folder and are registered per-syllable in vowels.json — each one instantly replaces the synthetic voice.

vowels.name: Fatha
vowels.desc: A short 'a' — the small slash above the letter. بَ says 'ba'.

vowels.name: Kasra
vowels.desc: A short 'i' — the small slash below the letter. بِ says 'bi'.

vowels.name: Damma
vowels.desc: A short 'u' — the little waw above the letter. بُ says 'bu'.

vowels.name: Sukun
vowels.desc: No vowel — the letter rests. بْ is just 'b', joined to the sound before it.

vowels.name: Fathatain
vowels.desc: Double fatha — the '-an' ending heard at the ends of words. بًا says 'ban'.

vowels.name: Dammatain
vowels.desc: Double damma — the '-un' ending. بٌ says 'bun'.

vowels.name: Kasratain
vowels.desc: Double kasra — the '-in' ending. بٍ says 'bin'.

vowels.name: Shadda + Fatha
vowels.desc: The shadda doubles the letter — بَّ says 'bba'. Press the letter, hold it, then release into the fatha.

vowels.name: Shadda + Damma
vowels.desc: Doubled letter into a damma — بُّ says 'bbu'.

vowels.name: Shadda + Kasra
vowels.desc: Doubled letter into a kasra — بِّ says 'bbi'.

vowels.name: Madd Alif
vowels.desc: Fatha stretched by alif — بَا says 'baa', held two counts.

vowels.name: Madd Waw
vowels.desc: Damma stretched by waw — بُو says 'buu', held two counts.

vowels.name: Madd Ya
vowels.desc: Kasra stretched by ya — بِي says 'bii', held two counts.
